Film Grain Effect

Add authentic monochromatic film grain to your photos with an adjustable intensity slider — the analog look, instantly.

10–25 subtle · 30–60 classic 35mm · 70+ gritty.

Monochromatic luminance grain, regenerated fresh on every adjustment. Processed locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Drag the intensity slider to taste — the preview updates live.
  3. Try 10–25 for subtle texture, 50+ for a gritty film look.
  4. Click "Download image" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is this real film grain?

Real film grain is random silver-halide clumps, not uniform noise. This tool adds per-pixel random luminance grain, which reads as authentic grain at normal intensities.

How strong should the grain be?

Drag the slider toward 100 for a gritty 35mm-pushed look, or keep it under 25 for a subtle texture.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — everything is computed on your photo's pixels in your browser.
